title: Headline fold headers (.hl-fold-head) stay 32/39 px tall under a coarse pointer: not on the card's 44 px floor list
claim: With the headline stats published (score_open), both `.hl-fold-head` buttons lay out 39 px and 32 px tall under a coarse pointer in all 36 coarse renders (de, en, sv x 375/768/1280 x light/dark x reduce/no-preference), 72 targets under D4-criteria F1's 44 px coarse floor, while every other HTML control of the state clears it.
mechanism: cardStyleBlock's htmlTargetFloor selector list applies `min-height: ${targetFloorPx}px` (44 px when _coarsePointer()) to the card's HTML controls; `.hl-fold-head` (R10-CARD-COLLAPSE's fold header, a <button>) was added later with its own fixed `min-height: 32px` and never joined that list.

evidence.unit: interactive targets under 24 px (44 px coarse), RESULT strict_small, all button.hl-fold-head in the coarse arm
evidence.machine: box B9, 4 vCPU, Chromium 158.0.8127.18 (playwright 1.65.0 lock, rev 1254), headless shell
evidence.contention_note: the seat's full M1 grid run ran beside it; a count of geometry, contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js:cardStyleBlock (htmlTargetFloor selector list) through the rendered heatpump-optimizer-card

perturbation.change: HPO_PERTURB='[["        .sp-filter, .sp-select,\n","        .sp-filter, .sp-select, .hl-fold-head,\n"]]' (adds the fold header to the floor list in memory)

metric_definition: Interactive elements (button, [role=button], tabindex, cursor:pointer roots) in the card's active scope whose border box is under 24 px (44 px coarse) on either axis.
phenomenon_property: Every HTML control the card renders meets the card's own pointer-keyed target floor (24 px, 44 px coarse): a control is on the floor list or carries a size at least as large.
seam_rule: dev/audit/rounds/round11/D4/s1/m1_browser.mjs (RESULT strict_small; m1_summarize.py <renders.jsonl> --check strictSmall groups it by element)

null_control.command: same command, fine-pointer arm of the same renders
null_control.note: Under a fine pointer the same buttons (32/39 px) clear the 24 px floor: 0 of the 36 fine renders count; the count is the coarse floor's alone.

reproduction_steps: run the command above; RESULT strict_small=72; python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D4/s1/m1_summarize.py <OUT>/renders.jsonl --check strictSmall --detail 4
re-run with the HPO_PERTURB above: RESULT strict_small=0
proposed_fix_scope: Add .hl-fold-head to cardStyleBlock's htmlTargetFloor selector list (or key its min-height on targetFloorPx).
